businesses.business: consumer packaged goods (household and personal care)

offering_description.value: Develops and markets branded household, personal care and specialty products such as baking soda, laundry detergent, cat litter, condoms, vitamins, oral care and hair removal. Sells mainly to consumers through mass retailers, plus a smaller specialty products business selling to industrial and animal nutrition customers. Uses its own and contract manufacturing plants.

primary_products.value: cat litter; laundry detergent; baking soda; condoms and personal lubricants; vitamins and supplements; oral care products; animal nutrition and specialty chemicals

customer_segment.value: B2C: household and personal care consumers buying branded products; B2B: retailers, wholesalers, and industrial, animal nutrition and food customers

end_markets.value: household cleaning; personal care; pet care; consumer health; animal nutrition; industrial specialty chemicals

revenue_model.value: product sales: branded consumer goods and specialty chemicals sold to retailers and industrial customers

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: markets branded consumer products, sold to mass retailers, drug stores, clubs and online retailers; OEM / manufacturer: manufactures baking soda-based and specialty products from purchased raw materials, sold to industrial customers

geography_served.value: global: United States primarily, plus Canada, Europe, Latin America, Asia-Pacific and other international markets

specialization.value: diversified: household, personal care and specialty products segments across many consumer brands

distribution_channels.value: third-party retail: mass merchandisers, grocery, drug stores, warehouse clubs; online: e-commerce retailers and direct-to-consumer sites; direct sales: industrial, animal nutrition and food customers; distributors / dealers: wholesalers and distributors
distribution_channels.category: third-party retail; online; direct sales; distributors / dealers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: consumer product safety, labeling and chemical rules, FDA oversight of condoms, OTC and supplement products, EPA rules
